newsitem.title: USA: Cisco to buy Skystone Systems, sees charge. [CORRECTED 23:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cisco to buy Skystone Systems, sees charge. [CORRECTED 23:15 GMT]

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire privately held Skystone Systems Corp.
Cisco said in a statement it will pay 1 million shares of Cisco common stock, worth about $66.5 million, and $22.6 million in cash for all outstanding shares, warrants and options of Skystone.
Cisco said it expects a one-time acquisition charge against after-tax earnings of between $0.08 and $0.13 a share in the fourth fiscal quarter of 1997.
(Company corrects range from "between $0.08 and $0.11" to "between $0.08 and $0.13")

The acquisition has been approved by the board of directors of both companies and is expected to be completed by mid-July subject to various closing conditions, including Skystone shareholder approval.
It said Ottawa-based Skystone develops semiconductor products for integrating several telecommunications functions for use in advanced fiber-optic networks.
